name: Nalmefene
summary: Nalmefene, sold under the brand name Revex among others, is a medication that is used in the treatment of opioid overdose and alcohol dependence. Nalmefene belongs to the class of opioid antagonists and can be taken by mouth, administered by injection, or delivered through nasal administration.

pharmacology.text: Nalmefene belongs to the class of opioid antagonists and can be taken by mouth, administered by injection, or delivered through nasal administration. In terms of its chemical structure and biological activity, nalmefene is similar to another opioid antagonist called naltrexone, as they are both derivatives of opiates.

uses.text: Nalmefene, sold under the brand name Revex among others, is a medication that is used in the treatment of opioid overdose and alcohol dependence. Nalmefene belongs to the class of opioid antagonists and can be taken by mouth, administered by injection, or delivered through nasal administration. Nalmefene is available as a generic medication.
uses.routes: By mouth, intranasal, intramuscular, intravenous, subcutaneous

sideEffects.en: Common side effects include nausea, dizziness, sleeplessness and headache. In someone dependent on opioids it can bring on sudden, severe withdrawal, and because it lasts a long time this withdrawal can last too.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括噁心、頭暈、失眠與頭痛。對鴉片類藥物依賴的人，它可能引發突然而嚴重的戒斷反應，而且因為作用時間長，戒斷也可能持續較久。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括恶心、头晕、失眠与头痛。对鸦片类药物依赖的人，它可能引发突然而严重的戒断反应，而且因为作用时间长，戒断也可能持续较久。

fact.en: Nalmefene is almost the same molecule as naltrexone. The only change is that an oxygen atom has been swapped for a carbon atom joined by a double bond.
fact.zh: 納美芬與納曲酮幾乎是同一個分子，唯一的差別是一個氧原子被換成以雙鍵相連的碳原子。
fact.zhHans: 纳美芬与纳曲酮几乎是同一个分子，唯一的差别是一个氧原子被换成以双键相连的碳原子。
